INSERT INTO ast_product_official_info (product_code, product_model, product_name, product_desc, technical_spec, product_category, product_type, list_price, crm_status, business_unit, product_line, org_id, source_created_at, source_updated_at, crm_state_code, crm_status_code, product_stage, end_of_sale_date, end_of_support_date, end_of_life_date, last_renewal_date, id, tenant_id, source_system, source_key, source_version, status, version, synced_at, creator, updater, create_time, update_time, deleted, sync_status) VALUES
(#{row.productCode}, #{row.productModel}, #{row.productName}, #{row.productDesc}, #{row.technicalSpec}, #{row.productCategory}, #{row.productType}, #{row.listPrice}, #{row.crmStatus}, #{row.businessUnit}, #{row.productLine}, #{row.orgId}, #{row.sourceCreatedAt}, #{row.sourceUpdatedAt}, #{row.crmStateCode}, #{row.crmStatusCode}, #{row.productStage}, #{row.endOfSaleDate}, #{row.endOfSupportDate}, #{row.endOfLifeDate}, #{row.lastRenewalDate}, #{row.id}, #{context.tenantId}, 'CRM', #{row.productCode}, #{row.sourceVersion}, CASE WHEN #{row.crmStateCode}=0 THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' END, 0, #{context.startedAt}, #{context.actorId}, #{context.actorId}, #{context.startedAt}, #{context.startedAt}, FALSE, 'SUCCESS') AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
id=CASE WHEN ast_product_official_info.tenant_id=incoming.tenant_id AND CAST(ast_product_official_info.product_code AS BINARY)=CAST(incoming.product_code AS BINARY) AND ast_product_official_info.deleted=FALSE AND CAST(ast_product_official_info.source_system AS BINARY) IN (CAST('CRM' AS BINARY),CAST('DPPMS' AS BINARY)) THEN ast_product_official_info.id ELSE NULL END, product_model=COALESCE(incoming.product_model,ast_product_official_info.product_model), product_name=COALESCE(incoming.product_name,ast_product_official_info.product_name), product_desc=COALESCE(incoming.product_desc,ast_product_official_info.product_desc), technical_spec=COALESCE(incoming.technical_spec,ast_product_official_info.technical_spec), product_category=COALESCE(incoming.product_category,ast_product_official_info.product_category), product_type=COALESCE(incoming.product_type,ast_product_official_info.product_type), list_price=COALESCE(incoming.list_price,ast_product_official_info.list_price), crm_status=COALESCE(incoming.crm_status,ast_product_official_info.crm_status), business_unit=COALESCE(incoming.business_unit,ast_product_official_info.business_unit), product_line=COALESCE(incoming.product_line,ast_product_official_info.product_line), org_id=COALESCE(incoming.org_id,ast_product_official_info.org_id), source_created_at=COALESCE(incoming.source_created_at,ast_product_official_info.source_created_at), source_updated_at=COALESCE(incoming.source_updated_at,ast_product_official_info.source_updated_at), crm_state_code=COALESCE(incoming.crm_state_code,ast_product_official_info.crm_state_code), crm_status_code=COALESCE(incoming.crm_status_code,ast_product_official_info.crm_status_code), product_stage=COALESCE(incoming.product_stage,ast_product_official_info.product_stage), end_of_sale_date=COALESCE(incoming.end_of_sale_date,ast_product_official_info.end_of_sale_date), end_of_support_date=COALESCE(incoming.end_of_support_date,ast_product_official_info.end_of_support_date), end_of_life_date=COALESCE(incoming.end_of_life_date,ast_product_official_info.end_of_life_date), last_renewal_date=COALESCE(incoming.last_renewal_date,ast_product_official_info.last_renewal_date), source_system=incoming.source_system, source_key=incoming.source_key, source_version=incoming.source_version, status=incoming.status, synced_at=incoming.synced_at, updater=incoming.updater, update_time=incoming.update_time, sync_status=incoming.sync_status, version=ast_product_official_info.version+1
